title: PSITE Region III Conducts Courtesy Visit to PSU President
content:
On behalf of PSITE Region III officers, Dr. Jonilo C. Mababa and Dr. Alma Theresa D. Manaloto paid a courtesy visit to Dr. Enrique G. Baking, EdD, President of Pampanga State University (PSU), to express their gratitude for the university's support of the upcoming RAITE 2026.

The PSITE delegation was warmly welcomed by Dr. Ranie B. Canlas, Dean Joel D. Canlas, and other PSU faculty members. The meeting provided an opportunity to discuss event preparations, partnership initiatives, and venue arrangements for the regional gathering of IT students and educators in Central Luzon.

The visit further strengthened the partnership between PSITE Region III and Pampanga State University in promoting excellence in IT education and student development.

title: 🚀 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐬.
content:
𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭. 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐎𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬. 𝐔𝐧𝐥𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐏𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬.

The 𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐀𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲 𝐄𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 (𝐑𝐀𝐈𝐓𝐄) 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 is officially opening its doors to the brightest minds, most creative talents, and future technology leaders across Central Luzon!

From programming, design, multimedia, esports, leadership, and performance arts to technical competitions, RAITE 2026 offers a platform where innovation meets excellence.

CTRL + NEXT: Empowering Students as Future-Ready Digital Innovators and Technology Leaders.

📅 September 11, 2026
